title: Harmonic approximation with affine decay (Simon Ch. 5, Lemma 3.1 and estimates 3.2–3.4)
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' → ∃ δh : ℝ, 0 < δh ∧ ∀ (R₀ : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℝ) (Lw : NNReal), 0 < R₀ → LipschitzWith Lw w → ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ‖fderiv ℝ w v‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₀ ^ n → (∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀ → ∀ G : ℝ, (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → |∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ w v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ δh * R₀ ^ n * G) → ∃ (a : ℝ) (b : Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ), ‖b‖ ≤ C ∧ |a| ≤ C * Real.sqrt ((∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R₀, w v ^ 2) / R₀ ^ n) + C * Real.sqrt ε' * R₀ ∧ ∀ θ' : ℝ, 0 < θ' → θ' ≤ 1 / 4 → ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) (θ' * R₀), (w v - a - b v) ^ 2 ≤ C * (ε' / θ' ^ (n + 2) + θ' ^ 2) * (θ' * R₀) ^ (n + 2)
